kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: As overdose deaths fall, White House makes misleading claims about who deserves credit
wire.summary: In a statement celebrating the historic drop in drug deaths, the White House pointed to successes since President Trump took office. In fact, the biggest progress happened under the Biden administration.

wire.title: Karl Kani dressed hip-hop royalty for decades. Now he's telling his own story
wire.summary: On NPR's Morning Edition , fashion designer Karl Kani talks about his new memoir, dressing some of hip-hop's biggest stars and why skinny jeans aren't for everyone.

wire.title: Got a canceled flight? 7 clever ways to get rebooked fast
wire.summary: Flying somewhere for Thanksgiving or the holidays? Travel insiders explain what to do if your flight gets canceled or delayed — so you can quickly get to your destination.

wire.title: Democrats formally nominate Hakeem Jeffries for speaker of the House
wire.summary: The New York Democrat moved a step closer to becoming the first Black lawmaker in U.S. history to serve in the job, after House Democrats voted overwhelmingly to support him.

wire.title: House Democrat warns 13 Trump allies to save their records for upcoming investigations
wire.summary: Among the recipients of letters from Robert Garcia, incoming chair of the House Oversight Committee, are Donald Trump Jr. and Eric Trump, Jared Kushner and White House Chief of Staff Stephen Miller.

wire.title: The off-and-on switch for U.S. aid leads to a cliffhanger for Zambia and Zimbabwe
wire.summary: After dismantling the United States Agency for International Development, the Trump administration is restarting foreign aid. In Zambia and Zimbabwe, there are different approaches but similar worries.

wire.title: Mary Peltola flips Alaska's Senate seat. And, Nvidia won't reinstate Jensen Huang
wire.summary: Former Democratic Rep. Mary Peltola has won one of the U.S.' most watched Senate races. And, Nvidia's board says it doesn't plan to reinstate former CEO Jensen Huang despite pressure from his allies.

wire.title: Greetings from a Berlin square, where an artist's statue watches over children at play
wire.summary: Children frolic around the ever-watchful and calm Käthe Kollwitz cast in bronze, in a square named after the German artist, whose work often depicted children in the wake of World War I.

wire.title: Grand Theft Auto VI is a grounded love story, a gonzo crime thriller and a gaming triumph
wire.summary: An inspired synthesis of violent satire and contemplative storytelling, Grand Theft Auto VI is more mature and ambitious than any prior game in the record-breaking franchise.

wire.title: Trump lands in China with key meetings with Xi and Putin on the agenda
wire.summary: Xi paid Trump a special honor by greeting him on the tarmac after Air Force One arrived in Shenzhen, reciprocating a gesture made by the U.S. president during Xi's visit to Washington in September.

wire.title: Inside the old gas pipeline where Ukraine is fighting an underground war with Russia
wire.summary: Watch: The BBC's Jonathan Beale joins Ukrainian forces taking the battle below ground and out of sight of Russian drones.

wire.title: 'The drones don't fly here' - BBC reports from Ukraine's new front line
wire.summary: Ukrainian forces are fighting Russian troops in an old Soviet tunnel in the Kharkiv region.

wire.title: Trump shakes hands with Putin and Xi ahead of historic talks in China
wire.summary: The three leaders will meet together for the first time on Thursday during a closely-watched summit.

wire.title: Israeli military launches rare ground operation in Gaza beyond Yellow Line
wire.summary: Hamas condemns the incursion, which the Israeli military says is dismantling a "terror tunnel", as a "flagrant" ceasefire violation.

wire.summary: The meeting in New Delhi was a late addition to the royal couple's India visit, which also included their appearance at the annual Earthshot Prize
